dc:description: One pooled degree × identified connection group × available specification × role state.
dc:title: Employment connection profiles
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: value: width_pct; numerator: n; denominator: denominator_n; connection: connection_clear as source categorical string 0/1; connection_label: connection_label; category: state; category_label: state_label
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
